headline: No scored news; lines drift as earlier stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores moved by only hundredths of a point as the effects of earlier announcements slowly faded. Enslaved God still leads at 41.09, followed by Conquerors at 34.62 and Self-Destruction at 30.30. Horizon Balance stayed at -12.86, unchanged in practice.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; the small drifts in Protector God and Enslaved God came only from earlier events fading.
